Needs changes before merge.

The alias uses the existing checked Solidcraft importer. The native dialog and viewport drops use the same extension list. No goldens changed. No `.nc` or `.cl` files changed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/state.rs:4676`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for the native Model Open filter change. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not commit images to the PR branch.

Local results:

I checked the current upstream rules at `abe24ff09d789757399cfcdf5f43c53ad9f9cbfb`. The trial merge with that main was already up to date. All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2448`, with its own target directory. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all 47 steps passed. Both app and UI test builds passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The UI library suite passed from `crates/ui`. The GPU checks passed on this machine.
- The native file dialog was not opened manually. Pixel snapshot tests were not run.

Safety checks:

This review used the safety tier because the alias changes geometry import routing. I repeated two mutations in the review worktree. I restored each file after the check. The final worktree had no tracked changes.

1. I restored upstream `crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs`. All three `solidcraft_extension_` pins failed with exit code 101. The route pin returned `Unsupported("part.solidcraft")`. The two MCP pins reported `unsupported file type`. I restored the PR file. All three pins passed with `--include-ignored`. The cached-body success pin passed in the same run (60.60 seconds for all three tests).
2. I restored upstream `crates/ui/src/state.rs`. `a_solidcraft_extension_drop_uses_the_model_filter_case_insensitively` failed with exit code 101. It reported `part.solidcraft is not a model file`. I restored the PR file. All three `egui_app::file_drop::tests` passed.

No golden diff required a line-by-line check. The PR changes no dependency, build script, workflow or process file.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: None. The only finding is the missing before/after screenshots of the native Model Open filter.

Screenshot capture is blocked in this session. `screencapture -x` failed with `could not create image from display`. AppKit reports zero screens, no GUI login session, and no screen capture access. I could not capture genuine native-dialog screenshots.

The head is unchanged: e6c93d9d328ea4c762beaac567dc572c8ecc482f. No files, tests, images, labels, or ready state were changed. The quick gate was started and stopped when the screenshot blocker was confirmed. Clippy was not run. No new pin or mutation check applies to this screenshot-only finding.

A session with an active macOS display is needed to capture the images, push them only to the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the PR body. Please re-review after that evidence is added.

Addressed: Added the missing before/after screenshots of the native Model Open filter to the PR body.

Evidence: the native dialog captures show `design.solidcraft` hidden before and visible after. Both use the same directory and Mesh filter. The `.stl` and `.sc` controls stay visible. The `.txt` control stays hidden.

The harness compiles each revision's `mesh_dialog` and `MODEL_EXTENSIONS` with the unchanged production `file_dialog.rs`. It opens real rfd/Zenity. The PR body states this capture method.

The images are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. Images commit: `e6f6caa87f70da7df92159895f1abf79a9274ab2`. No code changed. No new code pin or mutation check applies to this screenshot-only finding.

The existing filter pin `a_solidcraft_extension_drop_uses_the_model_filter_case_insensitively` passes in the UI suite.

Validation: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passes all 47 steps. It reports 1,666 passed tests, no failures, and 13 ignored tests. Clippy passes for `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui`, with all targets and warnings denied. The final runs used the compile cache disabled and an absolute local build directory.

Current PR head: `e6c93d9d328ea4c762beaac567dc572c8ecc482f` (unchanged). The plain branch push reports `Everything up-to-date`.

Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier screenshot finding is resolved. The PR body now links both native Model Open filter captures.
I opened both images. The Mesh filter hides `design.solidcraft` before the fix and shows it after the fix.
The `.stl` and `.sc` controls remain visible. The `.txt` control remains hidden.
The body states that the captures use a Linux/Xvfb native dialog harness.
The image commit is the current tip of the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch: `e6f6caa87f70da7df92159895f1abf79a9274ab2`.
The PR branch contains no screenshots or review evidence.

The alias uses the existing checked Solidcraft importer. The native dialog and viewport drops share one extension list.
The MCP description lists both extensions. The PR adds no dependency, build script, workflow or process change.
No goldens, `.nc` files or `.cl` files changed. No golden required a line-by-line check.

The first cache-backed build stopped making progress. I stopped that attempt.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all 49 steps passed. Both test builds passed.
- The gate recorded 1,781 passed tests, no failures, and 14 ignored tests.
- The UI library suite ran from `crates/ui`. The GPU checks passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 --target-dir target-local -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Safety mutations:

The review used the safety tier because the alias changes geometry import routing.
I repeated both mutations in the disposable review worktree. Each source file was restored after its mutation.

1. I removed the `solidcraft` route from `geometry/import/mod.rs`.
   All three `solidcraft_extension_` tests failed with exit code 101.
   The route returned `Unsupported("part.solidcraft")`. The MCP calls reported `unsupported file type`.
   After restoration, all three tests passed with `--include-ignored`.
   This run included the cached-body success test and took 108.69 seconds.
2. I removed `solidcraft` from the native `MODEL_EXTENSIONS` list in `state.rs`.
   `a_solidcraft_extension_drop_uses_the_model_filter_case_insensitively` failed with exit code 101.
   The error said `part.solidcraft is not a model file`.
   After restoration, the same test passed.

The final worktree has no tracked changes. There are no requested changes before merge.
This clean review replaces the earlier screenshot finding on this same head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
